asked.item: Why posts show 'Analytics not available' on the free trial
Pricing says trial includes everything except API, so why
Will old posts fill in once I pay

verdict.reason: The help pages state that analytics need a paid plan, that trial posts show "Analytics not available," and that older posts do not backfill, which answers both questions for this customer.

steps.text: Analytics need a paid plan, and on the free trial posts show "Analytics not available."
Analytics exist only for posts published while analytics was active on your account, and older posts do not backfill.
